case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's very central location near the sanctuary, friendly and attentive staff, clean comfortable rooms and good facilities; some appreciated on-site dining and welcoming touches. Recurring negative feedback concerned breakfast—limited options, no vegetables and an early finish time. Isolated comments mentioned morning light through shades and small service gestures like lending a kettle; one reviewer noted being a repeat guest.
